title: Researchers Find Residential Proxies on White House Network
description: Security researchers discovered that six IP addresses within the White House network were used as exit nodes by 28 residential proxy services over a month. The proxy activity mainly occurred in the evenings, suggesting a device regularly connected during those hours may be infected with proxy software. The traffic originated from Windows 11 machines running the InfaticaSDK, a proxy service provider. This finding indicates that devices on a sensitive government network may be unknowingly facilitating proxy traffic for external users.
